primary_source_citation.title: SMPTE Frame Rate & 180-Degree Shutter Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Standard theatrical motion pictures record at 24 frames per second with a 180-degree shutter angle yielding a 1 over 48 second exposure per frame.
core_mechanism_bullets: Standard theatrical motion pictures record at 24 frames per second with a 180-degree shutter angle yielding a 1 over 48 second exposure per frame.
The 180-degree axis of action rule keeps the camera on one side of two conversing subjects so screen direction and eyelines remain consistent across cuts.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Shooting at 24 frames per second requires setting shutter speed to 1 over 50 second and installing a neutral density filter outdoors to preserve natural motion blur.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Set two miniature figures on a table, draw the 180-degree line of action between them, and test how crossing the line reverses their left-right screen gaze.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: SMPTE Frame Rate & 180-Degree Shutter Standard: Standard theatrical motion pictures record at 24 frames per second with a 180-degree shutter angle yielding a 1 over 48 second exposure per frame. The 180-degree axis of action rule keeps the camera on one side of two conversing subjects so screen direction and eyelines remain consistent across cuts.

primary_source_citation.title: ASC Three-Point Lighting & Color Temperature Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Three-point cinema lighting pairs a 45-degree key light with a softer opposite fill light at a 2-to-1 ratio and a rear backlight for background separation.
core_mechanism_bullets: Three-point cinema lighting pairs a 45-degree key light with a softer opposite fill light at a 2-to-1 ratio and a rear backlight for background separation.
Camera white balance must match tungsten lamps at 3,200 kelvins or daylight fixtures at 5,600 kelvins to prevent orange or blue skin-tone casts.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Placing the key LED panel 45 degrees off camera axis and dimming the fill panel to 50 percent creates dimensional facial modeling with natural shadow roll-off.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Arrange three small flashlights around a portrait subject to demonstrate key, fill, and hair rim lighting while switching camera white balance between 3,200 kelvins and 5,600 kelvins.
